dedupe_keys.name: t14010 道路概況 延長等 roads bridges and tunnels

description: T14010_道路概況(延長等) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 熊本市. 熊本市内の道路概況（延長等）の推移 ※2011年度～2021年度（各年度末時点） ※出典は『熊本市統計書』と記載下さい。. Coverage: 熊本市. The portal files it under the publisher 熊本市. Its tags are 延長, 熊本市統計書, 統計情報, 道路. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Data License 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
